Thickness sweep — apples / breakfast (corrected colour pipeline, seed 3)

Same panel layout and seed as the color-fixed result; only the simulated shard-edge thickness shadow changes across renders. Key finding: the faceted mosaic and stray orphan shards are present already at zero thickness (tiling density / cross-talk placement, not the edge shadow). Only the dark cross-talk blotch growth and gridline fill-in scale up with thickness.

Recommended 1.5 mm as the visual/structural sweet spot — but this is really a material choice: the shadow simulates a real optical effect, so if the build uses 3 mm stock, 3 mm is the honest prediction. Thinner = cleaner image but weaker woven joints.
